column1: # We are running a STATELESS REST API behind JWT, so cookie / CSP / frame-rate
# checks that target classic HTML responses are downgraded to WARN, never FAIL,
# in the baseline. Anything related to information disclosure, transport
# security or injection stays at the default FAIL severity.

column3: (Incomplete or No Cache-control Header Set - acceptable on JSON 401/403)
(X-Frame-Options - not applicable on a pure REST API)
(Content Security Policy - REST API serves JSON)
(Non-Storable Content - irrelevant: 403 responses on /favicon.ico, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml are stateless API rejections, nothing to cache)
(Cookie Without SameSite - JWT in Authorization header, no cookies)
(CSP Scanner: failing alerts are not relevant for the JSON API surface)
(Permissions-Policy Header Not Set - not relevant for JSON API)
(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens - stateless JWT API, no CSRF surface)
(Sec-Fetch-Dest - this is a request header sent BY browsers, not a response header. ZAP flag is incorrect for any backend.)
